implementation: Acquire flock(LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB) on the already checked capture-directory fd; busy ownership raises the same fixed HOLD, and closing this fd releases only this invocation's lock. No lockfile or blocking wait.
Verify every preexisting final file without modifying it; stage only missing body/receipt files. Idempotent complete captures return after exact readback.

Use an invocation-owned 0700 TemporaryDirectory directly under the already approved runner parent, outside the flat capture inventory. Create 0600 stage files with O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW; fully write, flush, file-fsync and byte-readback all needed files before any final publication.

Publish with atomic os.link between pinned stage/root directory fds. An existing final name is never replaced or truncated and must independently match the complete expected bytes and private-file checks.

Track only newly staged inode identities before attempting a link, including an interrupted syscall. Remove each successful stage link so final files have nlink=1; independently byte-check both final files after private-stage cleanup and fsync the capture directory.

On failure, remove a candidate final only if its current dev/inode still matches this invocation's newly staged inode. Reverse order removes the receipt before its new body. Preexisting/shared files cannot match these new inode identities and are never unlinked, chmod'ed, relinked or rewritten. TemporaryDirectory cleanup removes invocation-owned staged files; rollback fsync is best effort, and any failure still follows the existing fixed SourceWait/latch.
